newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 3-, 12-mth discount T-bills Monday.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 3-, 12-mth discount T-bills Monday.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry said it will offer on Monday two discount T-bill issues with a total par value of 12 billion levs and with maturities of three and 12 months respectively.
The T-bills will be offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.

The maximum amount of paper a single bank can buy at the auctions through competitive bids is set at 15 percent of the par value earmarked for such bids for the three-month maturity and 35 percent for the one-year T-bills.
Of the total par of the issues on offer 95 percent are earmarked for competitive bids and the remaining five percent for non-competitive bids.
Par value 4.0 bln levs 8.0 bln levs
